parts.text:
RNA polymerase is composed of several polypeptides that move together and change shape as the enzyme performs its functions.

The death cap mushroom, *Amanita phalloides*, produces a toxin called alpha-amanitin, which binds to RNA polymerase at a site other than the active site. Alpha-amanitin reduces the activity of RNA polymerase.

Use the information provided to suggest how alpha-amanitin reduces the activity of RNA polymerase.
